outer.color_note: Material and finish of the vacuum shroud are not stated in the datasheet or product page (not_found: outer.color). Shroud inner diameter at the sample region is 73 mm (2.9 in) per the datasheet, i.e. a 152 mm OD / 73 mm ID puck 67 mm tall; mass 3.2 kg excluding transfer line. Flexible LHe/LN2 transfer line with integrated supply and return bayonets enters the side.

sample_space.description: Sample sits in vacuum (~1e-5 Torr during operation) on the 19.05 mm sample mount; accessed and exchanged from the top without removing the cryostat from the microscope. Working distance from objective to sample as short as 1 mm. Transmission geometry available via the optional bottom window.

notes: Standard ST-500 (not -C or -LGV), unwired, top window only, no magnet extension, no Infinite Helium recirculator: a 152 mm OD, 67 mm tall vacuum-shroud puck with a 73 mm ID sample region and a 19.05 mm cold-finger sample mount at 3.5-475 K, fed by a flexible LHe/LN2 transfer line with integrated supply and return bayonets (datasheet). Only visible motion is the cryogen flow (1.1 L/h LHe at 5 K) and the external vacuum pump the datasheet says every cryostat requires ('Each cryostat requires a pump to operate'); the cryostat body itself has no moving parts and is specified at <12 nm vibration and 2 nm/min drift at 4 K. Stability (+/-50 mK) and base pressure (~1e-5 Torr) are typical, not guaranteed. Window materials offered: UV fused silica, ZnSe, sapphire, CaF2 (top and bottom); bottom may be a blank plate. Sources: Lake Shore ST-500 Series datasheet (research/v5/cache/18e9f6b81e2ca517.txt) and SuperTran specification page https://www.lakeshore.com/products/categories/specification/environment-by-janis/lhe-and-ln-cryostats/supertran-continuous-flow-cryostats (research/v5/cache/2058d9a53b4f6bb0.txt) which repeats the same spec table and weight ~3.2 kg.
